function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_custom_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of all custom event specifications configured within the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

page.description: The page number for pagination, starting from 1.

page_size.description: The number of event specifications to return per page.

sort_by.description: The field by which to sort the returned events.

ascending.description: Determines if the sorting order is ascending (true) or descending (false).
